@granary.addServer.address.description: Add-server screen: the label of the box the address is typed in.

@granary.addServer.lead.description: Add-server screen: the line under the title.

granary.addServer.needsSetup: This server still needs its first-time setup. Finish it in the server's web interface.

granary.addServer.notAnAddress: That is not a server address.

@granary.addServer.opening.description: Add-server screen: the address is a saved server that is still signed in, so it opens again. {name}: the server's name.

granary.addServer.saveFailed: Granary could not save the server. Try again.

@granary.addServer.saveFailed.description: Add-server screen: the server was found but could not be saved on this PC.

granary.addServer.title: Connect to your Silo server

@granary.addServer.title.description: Add-server screen: its title, beside Silo's mark.

@granary.addServer.trying.description: Add-server screen: progress while one of the addresses the typed one may mean is tried. {address}: that address.

granary.apiFailure.busy: The server is busy, try again.

granary.apiFailure.unexpected: The server sent an answer this app does not understand.

@granary.apiFailure.unexpected.description: Something answered that is not the Silo server Granary expects, for example a proxy's page.

granary.apiFailure.unreachable: Could not reach the server. Check the connection and try again.

@granary.apiFailure.unreachable.description: The server could not be reached at all.

@granary.auth.tagline.description: Add-server and sign-in screens: the line under Granary's name. Silo is the server's name; keep it.

granary.loadError.denied: This profile isn't allowed to see this.

@granary.loadError.denied.description: Under a page or row that could not load because the server refused this profile (401 or 403). Granary's own: the web has no text for it.

@granary.loadError.gone.description: Under a page or row that could not load because the server no longer has it (404). Granary's own: the web has no text for it.

granary.profiles.changed: That profile has changed. Choose it again.

@granary.profiles.changed.description: Profile picker: the profile lost its PIN or was removed while its PIN was checked; the list was read again.

granary.profiles.empty: This account has no profiles yet.

@granary.profiles.empty.description: Profile picker: the account has no profile to pick.

@granary.profiles.listFailed.description: Profile picker: the server refused to list the profiles. {status}: the HTTP status, such as 500.

@granary.profiles.loading.description: Profile picker: what a screen reader says for the spinner while the profiles load.

@granary.profiles.noServer.description: Profile picker: no server is in use, so there are no profiles to show.

granary.profiles.openFailed: Could not open the profile. Try again.

@granary.profiles.openFailed.description: Profile picker: the picked profile could not be opened.

granary.profiles.pin.allDigits: {count, plural, one {Enter the # digit of the PIN.} other {Enter all # digits of the PIN.}}

@granary.profiles.pin.allDigits.description: Profile picker, PIN prompt: fewer digits were entered than a PIN has. count: the PIN's length, 4.

granary.profiles.pin.checkFailed: The PIN could not be checked (error {status}).

@granary.profiles.pin.checkFailed.description: Profile picker, PIN prompt: the server refused the check. {status}: the HTTP status, such as 500.

granary.profiles.pin.description: This profile is protected by a 4-digit PIN.

@granary.profiles.pin.titleNoName.description: Profile picker, PIN prompt: its title for a moment while it closes, when the profile's name is gone. With the name it is the web's Enter PIN for {name}.

granary.profiles.pin.unconfirmed: The server did not confirm the PIN. Try again.

@granary.profiles.pin.unconfirmed.description: Profile picker, PIN prompt: the server called the PIN right but sent nothing to open the profile with.

@granary.servers.active.description: Server list: the badge on the server Granary uses now.

@granary.servers.add.description: Server list: the button that opens the add-server screen.

@granary.servers.details.description: Server list: the line under the active server's name. {address}: its address; {name}: the signed-in account's username.

granary.servers.empty: No servers yet. Add a Silo server to get started.

granary.servers.error.serverProblem: {name} has a problem right now. Try again later.

@granary.servers.error.serverProblem.description: Server list: the server answered with an error of its own (5xx). {name}: the server's name.

granary.servers.error.settings: Granary could not save its settings on this computer. Try again.

@granary.servers.error.settings.description: Server list: the list of servers could not be written on this PC.

granary.servers.error.signInData: Granary could not read or save its sign-in data on this computer.

@granary.servers.error.signInData.description: Server list: the sign-in kept on this PC could not be read or written.

granary.servers.error.timeout: {name} did not answer in time. Try again.

@granary.servers.error.timeout.description: Server list: the server took too long to answer. {name}: the server's name.

granary.servers.error.unexpected: {name} sent an answer Granary does not understand. Check the server address.

@granary.servers.error.unexpected.description: Server list: something at the server's address answered, but not as a Silo server. {name}: the server's name.

granary.servers.error.unreachable: Could not reach {name}. Check the connection and try again.

@granary.servers.error.unreachable.description: Server list: the server could not be reached. {name}: the server's name.

@granary.servers.removeDialog.body.description: Server list: the question before a server is removed.

@granary.servers.removeDialog.confirm.description: Server list: the button that removes the server, in the question before it.

granary.servers.removeDialog.title: Remove {name}?

@granary.servers.removeDialog.title.description: Server list: the title of the question before a server is removed. {name}: the server's name.

@granary.servers.removed.description: Server list: the server was signed out of and removed. {name}: the server's name.

granary.servers.removedUnconfirmed: Removed {name}. The server did not confirm the sign-out.

@granary.servers.switchTo.description: Server list: what a screen reader says for the Switch button. {name}: the server's name.

@granary.servers.working.description: Server list: what a screen reader says for the spinner while a server is switched, signed out of or removed.

@granary.settings.about.automaticUpdates.description: Settings → About → Updates: the switch that lets Granary find, download and install its new versions by itself.

granary.settings.about.automaticUpdatesD: Look for new versions in the background and install them when Granary closes.

@granary.settings.about.automaticUpdates.description: Settings → About → Updates: under Automatic updates.

@granary.settings.about.checkForUpdates.description: Settings → About → Updates: the button that looks for a new version of Granary now.

@granary.settings.about.downloadAndInsta.description: Settings → About → Updates: with automatic updates off, the button that downloads a new version found and readies it to install.

@granary.settings.about.exceptionDescrip.description: Settings → About → License and source: under Platform library exception. Windows App SDK is a product name.

@granary.settings.about.lead.description: Settings → About: the line under Granary's name and version. Silo is the server's name; keep it.

@granary.settings.about.license.description: Settings → About → License and source: the row of Granary's license.

@granary.settings.about.licenseAndSource.description: Settings → About: the group with Granary's license, notices and source code.

@granary.settings.about.licenseAndSource.description: Settings → About: under License and source.

@granary.settings.about.noticesDescripti.description: Settings → About → License and source: under Third-party notices.

@granary.settings.about.openSource.description: Settings → About → License and source: what a screen reader says for the source code's Open.

granary.settings.about.sourceTooltip: Opens the repository in the browser

@granary.settings.about.sourceTooltip.description: Settings → About → License and source: the tooltip of the source code's Open.

@granary.settings.about.troubleshooting.description: Settings → About: the group with the folders of Granary's data and logs.

granary.settings.about.troubleshootingDe: Where Granary keeps its data on this computer, for when something goes wrong.

@granary.settings.about.updates.description: Settings → About: the group of Granary's own updates.

@granary.settings.about.updating.description: Settings → About → Updates: what a screen reader says for the spinner while Granary looks for or downloads an update.

@granary.settings.about.version.description: Settings → About: under Granary's name. {version}: its version, such as 0.3.2.

@granary.settings.about.view.description: Settings → About → License and source: the button that opens the license, the exception or the notices in a text editor.

@granary.settings.about.viewException.description: Settings → About → License and source: what a screen reader says for the exception's View.

@granary.settings.about.viewLicense.description: Settings → About → License and source: what a screen reader says for the license's View.

@granary.settings.about.viewNotices.description: Settings → About → License and source: what a screen reader says for the notices' View.

granary.settings.badges.cornerHint: Pick where it sits. Badges in the same corner stack.

granary.settings.playback.loadFailed: Could not load the playback settings. {reason}

@granary.settings.playback.loadFailed.description: Settings → Playback: above the groups when the profile's settings could not be read. {reason}: a short technical reason in English, such as 503 service_unavailable or timeout.

@granary.settings.playback.resetLearnedL.description: Settings → Playback → Quality: what a screen reader says for Reset beside the limit this connection learned while buffering.

@granary.settings.playback.resumeRewindN.description: Settings → Playback → This PC: what a screen reader says for the number box of Rewind on resume.

@granary.settings.playback.secondsUnit.description: Settings → Playback → This PC: the unit after the number box of Rewind on resume, which holds 0 to 30.

@granary.settings.playback.softwareDecod.description: Settings → Playback → This PC: a switch that lets Granary play files the graphics card cannot decode by decoding them on the processor.

granary.settings.playback.softwareDecodi: Play HEVC, VP9, AV1 and HDR files directly, decoding them on the processor where the graphics card can't, instead of having your Silo server convert them. The picture keeps its full quality, but slower PCs can stutter. Counts from the next title you play. With a fixed Quality above, your server can still convert a file.

@granary.settings.playback.softwareDecod.description: Settings → Playback → This PC: under Direct play without hardware decoding. HEVC, VP9, AV1 and HDR are format names; Quality is the setting above (settingsManifest preferred quality).

granary.settings.playback.stillWatchingD: How many episodes auto-play in a row before Granary asks whether you're still watching. Unlimited never asks, and Custom takes a number from 1 to 20.

@granary.settings.playback.stillWatching.description: Settings → Playback → This PC: under Still watching prompt. Unlimited and Custom are the select's choices.

granary.settings.playback.stillWatchingE: Episodes before the still watching prompt

@granary.settings.playback.stillWatching.description: Settings → Playback → This PC: what a screen reader says for the number box shown with Custom.

@granary.settings.playback.thisPc.description: Settings → Playback: the group of choices kept on this computer, not in the profile.

granary.settings.playback.thisPcDescript: Kept on this PC, not in your profile.
granary.settings.playback.upDown: Up and Down in the player

@granary.settings.playback.upDown.description: Settings → Playback → This PC: the choice of what the Up and Down arrow keys do while the picture shows.

@granary.settings.playback.upDownControl.description: Settings → Playback → This PC, Up and Down in the player: Up shows the controls and Down opens audio or subtitles, as on a TV.

granary.settings.playback.upDownDescript: While the picture shows. Controls and menus suits a remote, as on Silo's TV app: Up shows the controls, Down opens audio or subtitles. Volume is the keyboard shortcut of Silo's web player.

@granary.settings.playback.upDownDescrip.description: Settings → Playback → This PC: under Up and Down in the player. Controls and menus and Volume are its choices.

@granary.settings.playback.upDownVolume.description: Settings → Playback → This PC, Up and Down in the player: the arrow keys change the volume.

@granary.settings.playerButtons.audio.description: Settings → Playback → Player buttons: the player's button for the audio tracks.

granary.settings.playerButtons.audioNote: Shows when a title has audio tracks.

@granary.settings.playerButtons.audioNot.description: Settings → Playback → Player buttons: under Audio tracks.

@granary.settings.playerButtons.chapters.description: Settings → Playback → Player buttons: the player's button for a title's chapters.

granary.settings.playerButtons.chaptersN: Shows when a title has chapters.

@granary.settings.playerButtons.chapters.description: Settings → Playback → Player buttons: under Chapters.

granary.settings.playerButtons.descripti: Which buttons the player shows on the right of its controls, and in which order, for this profile on this PC. Some show only when a title has what they need. A hidden button's keys do nothing too, such as C for Subtitles.

@granary.settings.playerButtons.descript.description: Settings → Playback: under Player buttons. C is the keyboard key of Subtitles; keep it.

@granary.settings.playerButtons.editMark.description: Settings → Playback → Player buttons: the player's button that edits where intros and credits start and end.

granary.settings.playerButtons.editMarke: Shows when your account may edit markers.

@granary.settings.playerButtons.editMark.description: Settings → Playback → Player buttons: under Edit markers.

@granary.settings.playerButtons.fill.description: Settings → Playback → Player buttons: the player's button that makes the picture fill the screen.

@granary.settings.playerButtons.fullScre.description: Settings → Playback → Player buttons: the player's full-screen button.
Settings → Playback → Player buttons: under Full screen. F11 is a key; keep it.

@granary.settings.playerButtons.miniView.description: Settings → Playback → Player buttons: the player's button for a small window that stays on top.

@granary.settings.playerButtons.playback.description: Settings → Playback → Player buttons: the player's button that shows technical details of what plays.

@granary.settings.playerButtons.reset.description: Settings → Playback → Player buttons: what a screen reader says for Reset, which shows every button again in the first order.

@granary.settings.playerButtons.settings.description: Settings → Playback → Player buttons: the player's button that opens its settings panel.

granary.settings.playerButtons.settingsN: Speed, audio delay, version and quality.

@granary.settings.playerButtons.settings.description: Settings → Playback → Player buttons: under Playback settings.

@granary.settings.playerButtons.sleepTim.description: Settings → Playback → Player buttons: the player's sleep timer button.

granary.settings.playerButtons.sleepTime: Hiding it ends a timer that's running.

@granary.settings.playerButtons.sleepTim.description: Settings → Playback → Player buttons: under Sleep timer.

@granary.settings.playerButtons.subtitle.description: Settings → Playback → Player buttons: the player's subtitles button.

granary.settings.playerButtons.subtitles: Shows for titles from your Silo server.

@granary.settings.playerButtons.subtitle.description: Settings → Playback → Player buttons: under Subtitles.

granary.settings.playerButtons.title: Player buttons

@granary.settings.playerButtons.title.description: Settings → Playback: the group that chooses which buttons the player's bar shows on its right, and their order.

@granary.settings.playerButtons.volume.description: Settings → Playback → Player buttons: the player's volume button.

@granary.settings.playerButtons.volumeNo.description: Settings → Playback → Player buttons: under Volume.

granary.settings.posters.caption: Under each poster

@granary.settings.posters.caption.description: Settings → Navigation & Cards → Posters: the choice of what is written under each poster (title and details, title only, or nothing).

@granary.settings.posters.captionNothing.description: Settings → Navigation & Cards → Posters, Under each poster: nothing is written under a poster.

@granary.settings.posters.captionTitleAn.description: Settings → Navigation & Cards → Posters, Under each poster: the title and a line such as its year.

@granary.settings.posters.captionTitleOn.description: Settings → Navigation & Cards → Posters, Under each poster: only the title.

granary.settings.posters.description: How big posters are, and what's written under them, in Granary and Silo's other desktop apps.

@granary.settings.posters.description.description: Settings → Navigation & Cards: under the group Posters. The choice is shared with Silo's other apps for computers.

granary.settings.posters.deviceOverride: This PC has its own poster settings, so changes here won't show on it.

@granary.settings.posters.deviceOverride.description: Settings → Navigation & Cards → Posters: a notice when this computer keeps its own poster choice. As the web's notice, which says browser where Granary says PC.

@granary.settings.posters.loadFailedTitl.description: Settings → Navigation & Cards → Posters: the title of a panel in place of the choices when they could not be read.

@granary.settings.posters.matchOtherComp.description: Settings → Navigation & Cards → Posters: the button that drops this computer's own poster choice for the one the profile's other computers use.

granary.settings.posters.unsupportedDesc: Poster size and captions can be changed once your server runs a newer version of Silo.

@granary.settings.posters.unsupportedDes.description: Settings → Navigation & Cards → Posters: under the web's Your server needs an update, in place of the choices. Captions: what is written under each poster.

granary.settings.servers.lead: The Silo servers Granary knows. It uses one at a time; the others keep their sign-in.

@granary.settings.servers.lead.description: Settings → Servers: the line under the page's title.

granary.settings.sessions.footnote: Last seen records authenticated activity, updated at most once a minute. Older sessions may have no recorded activity yet. Signing out keeps the password and saved device settings.

@granary.settings.sessions.footnote.description: Settings → Devices: the note under the signed-in sessions. As the web's note, without its link to the account's password.

granary.settings.sessions.loadMoreFailed: Couldn't load more sessions. Reload the list.

@granary.settings.sessions.loadMoreFaile.description: Settings → Devices: Load more sessions failed; Refresh reads the list again.

@granary.settings.sessions.signOutThisDe.description: Settings → Devices: the Sign out button of Granary's own sign-in, which signs Granary out of the server. As the web's Sign out this browser.
Settings → Devices: the title of the question before Granary's own sign-in is signed out. As the web's Sign out this browser?

@granary.settings.sessions.thisDevice.description: Settings → Devices: the heading over Granary's own sign-in, and the badge on it. As the web's This browser.

@granary.settings.show.description: Settings: what a screen reader says for the switch of an entry in a list, such as a sidebar entry or a player button. {label}: the entry's name.

granary.settings.sidebar.description: What Granary's sidebar shows, and in which order, for this profile on this PC. Home, Search and Settings always show.

@granary.settings.sidebar.description.description: Settings → Navigation & Cards: under the group Sidebar.

@granary.settings.sidebar.reset.description: Settings → Navigation & Cards → Sidebar: what a screen reader says for Reset, which shows every sidebar entry again in its first order.

@granary.settings.sidebar.serverLogo.description: Settings → Navigation & Cards → Sidebar: a switch for the logo of the Silo server at the sidebar's top.

granary.settings.sidebar.serverLogoDescr: Shows the logo your Silo server's admin set in place of the server's name. A server without one shows its name.

@granary.settings.sidebar.serverLogoDesc.description: Settings → Navigation & Cards → Sidebar: under Server logo.

granary.settings.sidebar.serverOfferNote: Shows while your server offers it.

@granary.settings.sidebar.serverOfferNot.description: Settings → Navigation & Cards → Sidebar: under the entries Requests, Notifications and Watch Party, which show only while the server has them.

granary.settings.sidebar.title: Sidebar

@granary.settings.sidebar.title.description: Settings → Navigation & Cards: the group that chooses what Granary's sidebar shows and in which order.

@granary.settings.spoilers.loadFailedTit.description: Settings → Title Pages → Spoilers: the title of a panel in place of the switches when they could not be read.

granary.settings.spoilers.unsupportedDes: Spoiler settings can be changed once your server runs a newer version of Silo.

@granary.settings.spoilers.unsupportedDe.description: Settings → Title Pages → Spoilers: under the web's Your server needs an update, in place of the switches.

granary.settings.subtitles.loadFailed: Could not load the language and subtitle settings. {reason}

@granary.settings.subtitles.loadFailed.description: Settings → Language & Subtitles: above the groups when the profile's settings could not be read. {reason}: a short technical reason in English, such as 503 service_unavailable or timeout.

@granary.settings.subtitles.previewName.description: Settings → Language & Subtitles: what a screen reader says for the preview of the subtitles' look. {line1} and {line2}: its two sample lines (the web's Sample subtitle text, tuned for readability).

@granary.settings.subtitles.resetOffset.description: Settings → Language & Subtitles → Timing: what a screen reader says for Reset, which sets the subtitle offset back to 0 ms.

granary.settings.titleArt.ownChoiceNote: Only affects this PC. Your other devices keep their own setting.

@granary.settings.titleArt.ownChoiceNote.description: Settings → Title Pages → Title: under the switches while this computer has its own choice of title art. As the web's note, which says browser where Granary says PC.

granary.settings.titleArt.serverDefaultO: Using the server default (off). Change it here to choose for this PC.

@granary.settings.titleArt.serverDefault.description: Settings → Title Pages → Title: under the switches while neither this computer nor the profile chose, and the server's default has title art off. As the web's note, which says browser where Granary says PC.

granary.settings.titleArt.serverDefaultO: Using the server default (on). Change it here to choose for this PC.

@granary.settings.titleArt.serverDefault.description: Settings → Title Pages → Title: under the switches while neither this computer nor the profile chose, and the server's default has title art on. As the web's note, which says browser where Granary says PC.

granary.settings.titlePreview.descriptio: Home, For You and Discover open with a large picture of the title you point at. Off, they start with the rows.

@granary.settings.titlePreview.descripti.description: Settings → Navigation & Cards → Pages: under the switch Title preview at the top.

granary.settings.titlePreview.label: Title preview at the top

@granary.settings.titlePreview.label.description: Settings → Navigation & Cards → Pages: a switch for the large picture of a title at the top of Home, For You and Discover.

@granary.shell.backTooltip.description: The tooltip of the round back button at a page's top left. Alt+Left is the keyboard shortcut; name the keys as the keyboard does in the language.

@granary.shell.close.description: In full screen, the title bar's button that closes Granary's window, as Windows' own Close.

@granary.shell.exitFullScreen.description: The title bar's button that takes the window out of full screen.

@granary.shell.exitFullScreenTooltip.description: The tooltip of the title bar's button that takes the window out of full screen. F11 is the keyboard shortcut.

@granary.shell.fullScreen.description: The title bar's button, beside Windows' own, that puts the whole window in full screen.

@granary.shell.fullScreenTooltip.description: The tooltip of the title bar's full-screen button. F11 is the keyboard shortcut.

@granary.shell.notificationsUnread.description: What a screen reader says for the sidebar's Notifications while some are unread. count: how many.

@granary.shell.searchTooltip.description: The tooltip of the sidebar's Search. Ctrl+K is the keyboard shortcut; name the keys as the keyboard does in the language.

@granary.shell.starting.description: What a screen reader says for Granary's animated mark while the app starts.

granary.signIn.busy: The server is busy. Try again in a moment.

@granary.signIn.busy.description: Sign-in: the server answered that it is busy (503).

@granary.signIn.device.code.description: Sign-in: what a screen reader adds to the code shown under the QR code, which is typed on another device.

@granary.signIn.device.newCode.description: Sign-in: the button under the QR code once it was declined or did not work; it shows a new code.

@granary.signIn.device.panel.description: Sign-in: what a screen reader says for the box with the QR code and the code.

granary.signIn.device.qrImage: QR code to sign in. Scan it with your phone's camera.

@granary.signIn.device.qrImage.description: Sign-in: what a screen reader says for the QR code image.

granary.signIn.device.tooManyRequests: Too many requests. Trying again shortly…

@granary.signIn.device.tooManyRequests.description: Sign-in with a code: the server asks to slow down; Granary keeps asking on its own.

granary.signIn.device.unavailable: This server does not offer sign-in with a code. Use your password.

@granary.signIn.device.unavailable.description: Sign-in with a code: the server has no sign-in with a code; only the password form works.

granary.signIn.device.unreachable: Cannot reach the server. Still trying…

@granary.signIn.device.unreachable.description: Sign-in with a code: the server cannot be reached for a while; Granary keeps trying on its own.

@granary.signIn.device.validUntil.description: Sign-in: under the code, until when it works. {time}: a time of day, such as 14:05.

@granary.signIn.deviceOnly.description: Sign-in: the heading over the QR code when the server has no password sign-in, so the code is the only way. With password sign-in the heading is the web's Use your phone instead.

@granary.signIn.failed.description: Sign-in: the server refused in a way Granary has no words for. {status}: the HTTP status, such as 500.

granary.signIn.passwordDisabled: Password sign-in is turned off on this server. Sign in with the code instead.

@granary.signIn.passwordDisabled.description: Sign-in: the server refused the password because password sign-in is off; the QR code below still works.

granary.signIn.serverGone: This server is no longer saved. Add it again.

@granary.signIn.serverGone.description: Sign-in: the server to sign in to was removed meanwhile.

granary.signIn.tooManyAttempts.inAMinute: Too many attempts. Try again in a minute.

@granary.signIn.tooManyAttempts.inAMinut.description: Sign-in: too many attempts; the server asks to wait a minute at most.

granary.signIn.tooManyAttempts.later: Too many attempts. Try again later.

@granary.signIn.tooManyAttempts.later.description: Sign-in: too many attempts; the server did not say how long to wait.

granary.signIn.tooManyAttempts.minutes: {count, plural, one {Too many attempts. Try again in # minute.} other {Too many attempts. Try again in # minutes.}}

@granary.signIn.tooManyAttempts.minutes.description: Sign-in: too many attempts; the server asks to wait. count: the minutes, two or more.

@granary.signIn.unencrypted.accept.description: Sign-in: the button that agrees to sign in over a connection that is not encrypted.

granary.signIn.unencrypted.body: The server address starts with http://. Your password and sign-in would be readable by others on the network.

@granary.signIn.unencrypted.body.description: Sign-in: why a plain HTTP connection is a risk. Keep http:// as it is.

granary.signIn.unencrypted.title: This connection is not encrypted

@granary.signIn.unencrypted.title.description: Sign-in: the heading of the warning shown for a server at a plain HTTP address.

granary.signIn.unexpectedAnswer: {name} answered in a way Granary does not understand. Check the server address.

@granary.signIn.unexpectedAnswer.description: Sign-in: something at the server's address answered, but not as a Silo server. {name}: the server's name.

granary.signIn.unreachable: Can't reach {name}. Check the connection and try again.

@granary.signIn.unreachable.description: Sign-in: the server could not be reached. {name}: the server's name.

@granary.signIn.wrongCredentials.description: Sign-in: the server refused the username and password (401).

@granary.update.available.description: Settings → About → Updates, with automatic updates off: a new version was found. {version}: its version, such as 0.3.2.

granary.update.checkFailed: Couldn't check for updates. Check the connection and try again.

@granary.update.checkFailed.description: Settings → About → Updates: looking for a new version failed.

@granary.update.checking.description: Settings → About → Updates: while Granary looks for a new version.

granary.update.downloadFailed: Couldn't download Granary {version}. Check the connection and try again.

@granary.update.downloadFailed.description: Settings → About → Updates: Download and install failed; the version is still offered. {version}: its version, such as 0.3.2.

@granary.update.downloading.description: Settings → About → Updates: while a new version downloads. {version}: its version, such as 0.3.2; {percent}: how much is downloaded, 0 to 100. Write the percent sign as the language does.

granary.update.idleAutomatic: Granary looks for updates when it starts and every six hours.

@granary.update.idleAutomatic.description: Settings → About → Updates: before the first look, with automatic updates on.

@granary.update.idleManual.description: Settings → About → Updates: before the first look, with automatic updates off.

@granary.update.lastCheckedOn.description: Settings → About → Updates: when Granary last looked for a new version, on an earlier day. {date}: a day, such as Oct 26; {time}: a time of day, such as 09:12.

@granary.update.lastCheckedToday.description: Settings → About → Updates: when Granary last looked for a new version, today. {time}: a time of day, such as 14:05.

@granary.update.later.description: The notice of a downloaded update of Granary: the button that closes the notice; the update installs when Granary closes.

granary.update.notInstalled: This copy wasn't installed with Granary's setup, so it doesn't update itself.

@granary.update.notInstalled.description: Settings → About → Updates: this Granary was not installed by its setup program, so it cannot update itself.

granary.update.notVerified: The update to Granary {version} couldn't be verified, so it wasn't installed.

@granary.update.notVerified.description: Settings → About → Updates, with automatic updates off: the version downloaded is not a signed release. {version}: its version, such as 0.3.2.

granary.update.notVerifiedRetry: The update to Granary {version} couldn't be verified, so it wasn't installed. Granary will try again later.

@granary.update.notVerifiedRetry.description: Settings → About → Updates, with automatic updates on: the version downloaded is not a signed release; Granary looks again later. {version}: its version, such as 0.3.2.

@granary.update.notice.description: The notice of a downloaded update of Granary, at the window's bottom right. {version}: its version, such as 0.3.2.

granary.update.noticeHint: Restart now, or it installs when you close Granary.

@granary.update.noticeHint.description: The notice of a downloaded update of Granary: the line under its title.

granary.update.ready: Granary {version} is ready. It installs when you restart or close Granary.

@granary.update.ready.description: Settings → About → Updates: a new version is downloaded and verified. {version}: its version, such as 0.3.2.

@granary.update.restartNow.description: The notice of a downloaded update of Granary, and Settings → About with automatic updates on: the button that restarts Granary into the new version.

@granary.update.restartToUpdate.description: Settings → About → Updates, with automatic updates off: the button that restarts Granary into the new version it downloaded.

granary.update.summaryAutomatic: Granary looks for a new release when it starts and every six hours, downloads it in the background, and installs it when it closes.

@granary.update.summaryAutomatic.description: Settings → About: under Updates, with automatic updates on.

granary.update.summaryManual: Granary looks for a new release only when you check, and installs it only once you choose to.

@granary.update.summaryManual.description: Settings → About: under Updates, with automatic updates off.

granary.update.unsupportedBuild: This build doesn't look for updates.

@granary.update.unsupportedBuild.description: Settings → About → Updates: this Granary is a build that never updates itself, such as one made by a developer.

@granary.update.upToDate.description: Settings → About → Updates: no newer version was found.
